items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Nestill and see? ... [INTERVIEWEE] A dollar and a half, three meals a day.

ctx.x: Nestill and see? Manali's too? Yeah. Oh, you were promoted from dishwasher to delivery boy? Yeah. And then you delivered beer?
A dollar and a half, three meals a day.
